text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket had sustained an injury,
and was receiving treatment in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hah.
What's with that look on your face?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
It's nothin' big, just this much.
I'm the horse girl who's gonna be the "strongest," y'know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That's why... there's no way in hell I'm stopping now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer.
If it's just light training,
we should be able to manage.

Jungle Pocket wears a smile.
...However, the corners of her mouth twitched slightly.
choice_data_list: If you want to be the "strongest," you should rest for now.
...If you promise not to overdo it.

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's a detour,
she should head toward her goal in peak condition.
Persuading her of this—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Can't be talkin' like that.
There's a whole bunch of others out there
aimin' for the top, y'know?
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still the strongest, aren't you?
Even so, you're still the strongest, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no need to rush.
...Let's just take it easy for now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: Any more training than this is impossible...!
Any more training than this is impossible...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it!
Is this all I've got...?!

Jungle Pocket's injury worsened,
forcing her to take time off to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
choice_data_list: ...Looks like there's no problem with your movement!
...Looks like there's no problem with your movement!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! Didn't I tell ya?
Something like this ain't no big deal!

Jungle Pocket nursed her injury back to health
while keeping her body moving within reasonable limits.
